translation_en: Who is doing the household chores today?

sentence: Bist du mit dem Putzen dran?
translation_en: Is it your turn to clean?
No, it was my turn yesterday.
Yes, I will vacuum the living room.
Who is taking out the trash?

tip: Suggesting a solution for a flatshare.

sentence: Der Putzplan hängt in der Küche.
translation_en: The cleaning schedule hangs in the kitchen.

sentence: Wer putzt diese Woche das Bad?
translation_en: Who is cleaning the bathroom this week?

tip: Promising to clean a neuter room.
translation_en: I will clean it on Saturday.
Then I will iron your shirts.

sentence: Das ist sehr nett von dir.
translation_en: That is very nice of you.

sentence: Ich habe eine Nachricht für dich.
translation_en: I have a message for you.

sentence: Der Zettel liegt auf dem Tisch.
translation_en: The note is on the table.

sentence: Ja, ich rufe dich später an.
translation_en: Yes, I will call you later.
Are you visiting us on Sunday?

tip: Confirming a visit to multiple people.
translation_en: Yes, I will gladly visit you all.

sentence: Ich sehe Sie nicht, Herr Müller.
translation_en: I don't see you, Mr. Müller.

tip: Asking if someone asks a male.

sentence: Wir streiten oft über den Haushalt.
translation_en: We often argue about the household chores.

tip: Asking someone not to be mad.
